title: monAp_pg — Instance
description: Page d'une instance : état de ses indicateurs et, heure par heure sur les 3 dernières heures, CPU, verrous, deadlocks, transactions et disque.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM asemon.instances WHERE enabled ORDER BY instance_id
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM asemon.instances WHERE enabled ORDER BY instance_id

panels.title: État actuel
panels.description: Dernière valeur de chaque indicateur de l'instance, comparée à ses seuils (modifiables sur la page Seuils).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS "Indicateur", unit AS "Unité", round(value::numeric, 1) AS "Valeur",
       warn_value AS "Avertissement", crit_value AS "Alarme", state AS "État", value_ts AS "Mesuré à"
FROM asemon.v_kpi_status WHERE instance_id = $instance ORDER BY sort_order

panels.title: Les 3 dernières heures, une ligne par heure (heures UTC, la dernière est partielle)
panels.description: CPU : pic de la machine (pas de PostgreSQL) et heure du pic. Attente de verrou : plus longue attente d'une même exécution sur un verrou (échantillons de 2 s), avec le nombre maximal de sessions bloquées au même instant. Deadlocks : nombre dans l'heure. Transactions ouvertes : maximum de sessions ayant une transaction ouverte au même instant, idle in transaction comprises. Disque : espace libre minimal de /. Transaction la plus longue : précision 15 s. Sans activité, verrous et transactions valent 0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hrs AS (
  SELECT g AS hour FROM generate_series(date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours', date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC'), interval '1 hour') g
), os AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', collected_at, 'UTC') AS hour, max(cpu_percent) AS cpu,
         (array_agg(collected_at ORDER BY cpu_percent DESC NULLS LAST))[1] AS cpu_at,
         min(100.0 * disk_free_bytes / NULLIF(disk_total_bytes, 0)) AS disk
  FROM asemon.snap_os WHERE instance_id = $instance AND collected_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY 1
), lk AS (
  SELECT hour, max(ms) / 1000.0 AS wait FROM (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', sampled_at, 'UTC') AS hour, session_key, query_start, sum(interval_ms) AS ms
    FROM asemon.snap_samples
    WHERE instance_id = $instance AND sampled_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'
      AND COALESCE(application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) x GROUP BY 1
), lkn AS (
  SELECT hour, max(n) AS blocked FROM (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', sampled_at, 'UTC') AS hour, sampled_at, count(DISTINCT session_key) AS n
    FROM asemon.snap_samples
    WHERE instance_id = $instance AND sampled_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'
      AND COALESCE(application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%'
    GROUP BY 1, 2) x GROUP BY 1
), dl AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at, 'UTC') AS hour, count(*) AS n
  FROM asemon.event_deadlocks WHERE instance_id = $instance AND occurred_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY 1
), ax AS (
  SELECT hour, max(n) AS xacts FROM (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', collected_at, 'UTC') AS hour, collected_at, count(*) AS n
    FROM asemon.snap_activity
    WHERE instance_id = $instance AND collected_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%'
    GROUP BY 1, 2) x GROUP BY 1
), lx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', collected_at, 'UTC') AS hour,
         max(extract(epoch FROM collected_at - xact_start)) AS longest
  FROM asemon.snap_activity
  WHERE instance_id = $instance AND collected_at >= date_trunc('hour', now(), 'UTC') - interval '2 hours' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT hrs.hour AS "Heure",
       round(os.cpu::numeric, 1) AS "CPU pic (%)", os.cpu_at AS "Heure du pic",
       round(COALESCE(lk.wait, 0)::numeric, 1) AS "Attente de verrou max (s)",
       COALESCE(lkn.blocked, 0) AS "Sessions bloquées max",
       COALESCE(dl.n, 0) AS "Deadlocks",
       COALESCE(ax.xacts, 0) AS "Transactions ouvertes max",
       round(os.disk::numeric, 1) AS "Disque libre min (%)",
       round(COALESCE(lx.longest, 0)::numeric, 0) AS "Transaction la plus longue (s)"
FROM hrs
LEFT JOIN os USING (hour) LEFT JOIN lk USING (hour) LEFT JOIN lkn USING (hour)
LEFT JOIN dl USING (hour) LEFT JOIN ax USING (hour) LEFT JOIN lx USING (hour)
ORDER BY hrs.hour DESC
